baseSource: Level 45 base stats the API doesn't report, calibrated from one Spiritmaster's in-game stat window (Oct 2026): the gap between the window and the rebuilt sheet, after % increases.
assumptions: Cast times are estimates (1.0s for most skills, 0.8s for summons) scaled by Combat Speed; the client does not publish them.
Spirits use your Attack and damage multipliers. Fire, Water and Ancient spirits gain +2% Attack per skill level, as their tooltips say.
Spirit basic attacks hit every 2.0s for 50% of your Attack. This is a placeholder until DPS-meter logs calibrate it.
Damage-over-time numbers in tooltips are treated as the total over the effect's duration, not per tick.
You swap summons as they come off cooldown so each summon triggers its spirit's skill, building Four Elements for Elemental Fusion.
Bosses are treated as immune to crowd control, and skills that need a Staggered target (Rapid Scattershot) are not used.
Stigma specializations are not exposed by the API, so none are applied.
Each cast is followed by a 0.05–0.25s reaction delay (average 0.15s), varied per cast.
Level 45 base stats the API doesn't report (Critical Hit 120, Accuracy 144, MP 1,910, …) are calibrated from one player's in-game stat window.
MP regenerates 30 MP/s; Combustion is used while MP allows, otherwise Cold Shock.
